name: dblp
description: dblp computer science bibliography. The CLI searches publications, authors and venues through dblp's public search API, and fetches author bibliographies and single records (XML/BibTeX).
notes: The recording has no working endpoints. Every request, including the homepage and /pid/, returned the Anubis bot wall ('Oh noes!' / 'Access Denied'). None of these commands has been verified against a live response.

All six commands are based on dblp's publicly documented API (dblp FAQ: 'How to use the dblp search API') and its standard XML/BibTeX record exports, not on observed traffic. Response paths (result.hits.hit, dblpperson, dblp) follow that documentation.

If Anubis still blocks non-browser clients, every command will return an HTML 'Access Denied' page instead of data. Try the mirror origin https://dblp.uni-trier.de with the same paths. Callers should check for an 'Oh noes!' title.
robots.txt disallows /search. dblp asks API users to keep requests modest (roughly no more than one per second) and to cache results.
Typical flow: search-authors → take the pid from info.url (the part after https://dblp.org/pid/) → get-author-publications. Or: search-publications → info.key → get-record / export-bibtex.
Paging: limit (h) is capped at 1000, and offset (f) is the 0-based index of the first hit. result.hits['@total'] gives the total match count.
